prompt:
Create a production transparent desktop-pet sprite atlas based ONLY on the reference adult character's identity, face, hair, accessories, EXACT CLOTHING, shoes, adult proportions and polished 3D rendering. This is animation artwork, NOT a UI.
Portrait canvas 1024x1536, exactly FOUR columns and FOUR rows, 16 separate full-body poses in reading order. Each invisible cell is 256x384 with generous empty transparent gutters on all four sides. All characters complete, no cropped hair, shoes, hands or train. Same adult head size and limb lengths across all poses: seated and curled poses must occupy LESS height, never enlarge them to fill the cell. Standing figures ONLY 260px tall and maximum 190px wide, seated figures about 150px tall, sleeping figures about 85px high and maximum 210px wide. Each cell includes the entire character and any blocks. Keep generous margins. NO CHIBI.
Row 1: (1) listening calmly, closed mouth, relaxed hands low in front; (2) speaking softly, slightly open mouth, one open palm gently gestures near waist; (3) daydreaming silently, closed mouth, relaxed gaze up and to the side, hands behind back, not gesturing; (4) jump preparation, knees clearly bent, hips lowered, arms swept back.
Row 2: (5) airborne jump, BOTH knees bent with feet tucked off the ground and arms raised, lively adult full-body pose; (6) landing, knees bend to absorb the landing, feet together, arms balance; (7) sitting ON the floor with both knees drawn to the chest, arms wrapping shins, feet in front, not squatting; (8) tightly curled seated hug, head resting ON knees, arms hugging shins, bottom on floor, clearly compact not standing.
Row 3: (9) sleeping on her SIDE in a compact fetal curl on the floor, eyes closed, cheek rests on her hands, bent legs tucked together, no cushion or bed; (10) sitting/kneeling beside two loose pastel wooden cubes, fingers visibly grasp a cube ready to stack; (11) same seated pose, hand visibly places a blue cube ON a small red-and-green two-cube tower; (12) same seated pose, hand just releases the finished three-cube tower, pleased calm expression. Blocks genuinely touch hands during placement, consistent small cubes, no floating objects.
Row 4: (13) being gently lifted from the floor, heels lifting, shoulders raised, arms loosely raised, whole body extends, no external person or hand; (14) suspended/dangling, legs visibly hang with both knees bent a little, toes pointing down, arms out for balance, surprised gentle expression; (15) harmless toy-ball bump reaction, shoulders flinch backwards, eyes squeeze shut, forearms protect chest, NO ball drawn; (16) a missed ball reaction, looks down to one side, palms turn outward in a small shrug, closed mouth, NO ball drawn.
Maintain coherent anatomy, clean silhouette, precise hands, no stretched textures. Wedding clothing if present remains long cloth with legs correctly folded underneath. No text, numerals, labels, borders, shadows, backgrounds, glow or scattered decoration. True clean alpha transparency. The atlas must have exactly 16 figures separated by transparent gutters and preserve the exact reference outfit in every cell.
CRITICAL PRODUCTION LAYOUT: zoom OUT and keep the artwork small. Exact regular 4 by 4 grid; figure in row 1 entirely between y=40 and 335, row 2 entirely between y=425 and 720, row 3 between y=810 and 1105, row 4 between y=1195 and 1490. Every figure fully inside its own 256x384 cell, transparent gutters of at least 22px. No pair of characters may touch even by a hair strand. No body part may touch a canvas boundary. Every standing character has complete feet and shoes. Pose 9 must have BOTH eyes closed asleep. First reference is the only identity and outfit reference. Preserve its 3D animated face and rendering. Nonsexual ordinary everyday activity, full coverage clothing in each pose, neutral straight-on camera.
